answer: An attacker running 90 aliases thus needs 135 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in lotus, expire in mesa, and voyage lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1277 identities would post 3977 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
